description: 64 controlled multiple-choice rationale checks: threshold sensitivity, evidence lookup, causal intervention, and minimal sufficient changes. Higher means better rationale selection.
limitations: Behavioral rationale-check proxy only: not mechanistic interpretability, hidden-reasoning faithfulness, or coverage of model internals. Four synthetic families are correlated and may be easy; Wilson intervals are descriptive. Format failures are incorrect. Chance reference: 25%.
